# simshot

> App Store screenshot capture CLI — simctl only, no XCUITest, no hangs.

simshot captures App Store-ready screenshots from the iOS Simulator by driving `simctl` directly (build → boot → status bar override → launch with scene args → `io screenshot` → resize). The app under test implements a tiny `#if DEBUG` launch-argument handler to navigate to each scene.

- Repo: <https://github.com/kichiemon/simshot>
- License: MIT
- Written in Swift (SwiftPM), macOS 13+, zero third-party dependencies.

## Key facts

- Binary/product name: `simshot`; core library module: `SimshotCore`; test target: `simshotTests`.
- Commands: `simshot shoot`, `simshot devices`, `simshot doctor`, `simshot init [--yes] [--output <path>]`, `simshot verify [dir] [--devices <list>] [--langs <list>] [--json]`, `simshot version`, `simshot help`.
- `simshot doctor` checks xcode-select / Xcode / simctl / iOS runtimes / available simulators and exits 1 if a check fails.
- Works with Xcode 27 (Device Hub): simshot drives `xcrun simctl` only and never opens `Simulator.app`, so Device Hub replacing the Simulator app does not affect it.
- `simshot init` writes a commented `simshot.yml` scaffold (interactive, or non-interactive with `--yes`).
- `simshot verify` checks an output tree against App Store screenshot requirements (exact accepted dimensions, no alpha channel, no mixed sizes, no empty folders); `raw/` is skipped, `--json` for machine output, exit 1 when a problem is found.
- `simshot shoot` flags: `--project`/`--workspace`/`--scheme`, `--app-path`, `--bundle-id`, `--devices`, `--langs`, `--locales`, `--shots <config.json>`, `--scenes`, `--wait`, `--output`, `--resize`, `--derived-data`, `--timeout`, `--status-bar-time`, `--status-bar-battery`, `--no-ui-testing`, `--no-clean`, `--keep-running`, `--verbose`.
- Output layout: `appstore/raw/<device>/<lang>/NN_name.png` (raw) and `appstore/<device>/<lang>/NN_name.png` (App Store-ready when `--resize`).
- App Store size targets come from Apple's published list: 1320×2868 / 1290×2796 / 1260×2736 / 1284×2778 / 1242×2688 / 1206×2622 / 1179×2556 / 1170×2532 / 1125×2436 / 1080×2340 / 1242×2208 / 750×1334 (iPhone) and 2064×2752 / 2048×2732 / 1668×2420 / 1668×2388 / 2266×1488 / 1640×2360 / 1668×2224 / 1536×2048 / 768×1024 (iPad); alpha is flattened to white; resizing is LANCZOS-equivalent via CoreGraphics/ImageIO. A capture already on an accepted size keeps its resolution.

## Screenshot scene protocol (public contract)

simshot launches the app with:

```
--ui-testing
--screenshot-scene <scene>
--screenshot-strokes <N>        (optional)
--screenshot-scroll-bottom      (optional)
```

plus `-AppleLanguages (lang)` and `-AppleLocale <locale>`. The app must interpret these under `#if DEBUG` to navigate to the scene. Scene names and behaviors are owned by the app; simshot only passes them through. Changing this protocol requires updating `README.md`, `README.ja.md`, `README.ko.md`, and `Sources/SimshotCore/ShotSpec.swift`.

## Install

- Single binary (macOS arm64/x86_64): `curl -sL https://github.com/kichiemon/simshot/releases/download/v0.2.1/simshot-macos-<arm64|x86_64> -o /usr/local/bin/simshot && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/simshot`
- Nix: `nix run github:kichiemon/simshot` / `nix profile install github:kichiemon/simshot` (the repo's `flake.nix` fetches the prebuilt binary from GitHub Releases)
- mise: `mise use -g github:kichiemon/simshot` — recommended github backend (SLSA-verified); legacy `ubi` backend (`ubi:kichiemon/simshot`) also works but is deprecated in mise 2027.1.0
- npx (agent skill): `npx skills add kichiemon/simshot` — skill-aware agents then use simshot automatically (skill at `skills/simshot/SKILL.md`); for OpenAI Codex use `npx skills add kichiemon/simshot -a codex` (installs to `.agents/skills/`; the skill is synced across `skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`)
- Build from source: `swift build -c release` (binary at `.build/release/simshot`)
- Homebrew: `brew tap kichiemon/homebrew-tap && brew install simshot` (prebuilt binary via tap formula)
- npm (published, `simshot`): `npm i -g simshot` / `npx simshot shoot` — downloads a prebuilt single binary (arm64/x86_64) with sha256 verification in `postinstall` (see `npm/`; macOS, Node 14+)

## Build & test

```bash
swift build   # build
swift test    # run tests (XCTest)
```

CI runs on `macos-latest` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`); releases are cut from `v*` tags (`.github/workflows/release.yml`).
